birth_rule: A retains all displacement and plastic/material history. B receives affine displacement ux=-.001x,uy=-.001y,uz=.0025z with shared values restored; new incremental material strain/stress/plastic history is zero. No reference reset on A.
event_order: Each ending-time-labelled step: controls toggle internal/top axial BCs; TIMESTEP_BEGIN birth modifier group-100 reinitializes only changed B; temperature update; begin nodal sampling group100; equilibrium; end full nodal/cell fields. Birth at3, cooldown4, release5.
assumptions: Prescribed uniform temperature, no heat equation, latent heat, annealing or physical process.
Small strain, isotropic elasticity, nu=0, perfect J2. No physical alloy.
Two equal serial segments share nodes and traction at z10; same active physics block2, logical segment identity determined by immutable z coordinate.
Support release is quasi-static boundary removal; elastic energy decrease is not a dynamic energy-conservation claim.
tensor_sampling: All6 symmetric components of4 tensors at every2x2x2Gauss point, via a value-only AD-to-real conversion and scalar component materials; no cell averages.
